home.about: Ikatisetse yunibesiti pele e nna ya mmatota. Dira moithuti wa gago, tshela mo dinakong tse di ntshang baithuti ba Aforikaborwa (madi a a diegang, dikopo tsa lelapa, dibeke tsa diteko, bodutu), mme o bone tshegetso e e leng teng pele o e tlhoka.
home.about2: Morago ga kgaolo nngwe le nngwe, Ponelopele ya Semesetara e bala ditshwetso tsa gago, e bolele pele dibeke tsa gago tse di kotsi go gaisa mme e go agele leano la go tshela le o ka le bolokang.
ob.skip: Tlola o ye mo loetong lwa me
why.tag: Ke ka ntlha yang fa se le botlhokwa
why.title: Go tsena ga se karolo e e thata. Go nna ke yone.
why.stat1: Baithuti ba ngwaga wa ntlha ba ka nna 620 000 ba ba neng ba tshegediwa ke NSFAS ka 2023. Ke ba ka nna 130 000 fela ba ba neng ba sa ntse ba tshegediwa ngwaga morago.
why.stat2: Dikakanyo dingwe di bontsha gore go fitlha go 60% ya baithuti ba ngwaga wa ntlha ba tsamaya morago ga kotara ya bone ya ntlha.
why.i1: Madi a a fitlhang a diegile, le rente e e tshwanetseng go duelwa pele madi a fitlha
why.i2: Lelapa le kopa madi a le wena o a tlhokang
why.i3: Ga go na laptop, ga go na data, kgotsa loeto lo loleele
why.i4: Go nna kgakala le gae, le bodutu
why.i5: Diteko le ditiro tse di fitlhang tsotlhe mo bekeng e le nngwe
why.i6: Kgatelelo ya maikutlo, matshwenyego le go lapa go feta selekanyo
why.i7: Go dira tiro, kgotsa go tlhokomela mongwe, o ntse o ithuta
why.i8: Mojule o o paletsweng ke one, kgotsa dituelo tsa bogologolo tse di thibelang kwadiso
why.everyone: Se ke sa botlhe: NSFAS, bursary, ba ba tshegediwang ke lelapa kgotsa ba ba ipatelang; ba ba tswang kwa sekolong kgotsa ba ba boang ba setse ba godile; ba ba nnang kwa residence, ba ba hirang kgotsa ba ba palamang; ngwaga wa ntlha kgotsa ba ba setseng ba le mo ngwageng wa bobedi. Mathata a a a bonala pele, le thuso e jalo.
how.title: Ikatise, morago o boloke leano
how.s1: Seemo sa gago sa mmatota: yunibesiti, thuto, bonno, tshegetso ya madi, madi, gae le maikarabelo. Motshameko o agiwa ka sone.
how.s2t: Tshameka ngwaga wa gago, beke ka beke
how.s4t: Bona ponelopele le leano la gago
how.s4: Morago ga kgaolo nngwe le nngwe, Ponelopele ya Semesetara e bolela pele dibeke tsa gago tse di kotsi go gaisa mme e age leano la go tshela le o ka le bolokang kgotsa wa le abelana mo WhatsApp.
home.card.setupNew: Dira moithuti wa gago: yunibesiti, thuto, gae, madi le tse dingwe. Go tsaya motsotso o ka nna mongwe.
home.card.setupDone: Moithuti wa gago o setse a siametse.
home.card.firstDesc: Go goroga, Kotara ya Ntlha, Ditlhatlhobo tsa Ntlha le go Boela mo Seemong: ngwaga o baithuti ba bantsi ba o fitlhelang o le thata go gaisa.
home.card.middleDesc: Ngwaga wa bobedi le wa boraro: dituelo tsa bogologolo, go fudugela kwa ntle ga khampase, go tlhopha thuto e kgolo, ditiro tsa fa thoko le go lapa.
home.card.finalDesc: Diporojeke tsa ngwaga wa bofelo, dikopo tsa tiro, dikoloto tsa bogologolo le letsatsi la kabo ya dikerata.
